messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Latency SLO breach on inference.prod.us-west1 — p95 and p99 elevated. PagerDuty PD-12345 triggered and auto-paged. Details: grafana/redwood/inference -> https://grafana.company/alerts/xyz

alex_oncall: Acked PD-12345. I'm on it, pulling traces and logs.

ben_sre: Seeing p99 ~4200ms, p95 ~950ms. Spike started ~12:32 UTC. KV cache eviction rate increased around same time. No error-rate spike to customers yet.

carla_eng: Any 503s or failed requests reported by support?

support_tim: Two customer tickets so far reporting slow responses (ticket# 7891, 7892). No widespread 5xx. They're saying generation took >5s.

ben_sre: quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:22Z] tail_latency_ms p99=4200 p95=950 qps=1800
hotkeys=0.03% kv_evictions=12/min
batcher_queue_len=42 max_batch_size=64
```

alex_oncall: Plan: 1) scale inference-runtime pool (prod) 2) temporarily reduce batch size to 16 3) route non-critical tenants to lightweight model variant. Applying scale now.

alex_oncall: Running: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=16 -n prod`

incident-bot: Autoscaler hint: recommended replicas=16 for observed qps. Note: regional GPU quota near limit in eu-west, fallback routing advised.

ben_sre: Scale applied, reducing max_batch_size on batcher config to 16 -> pushing config. Also toggling prefix KV warmup to reduce cold evictions.

carla_eng: Adding temporary routing rule to divert traffic for customers in group=non-sla to model=llama-lite. Patch sent as PR #4521, will promote. Config snippet:
```
route /v1/generate {
  if tenant.group == "non-sla" {
    model: "llama-lite"
    priority: low
  }
}
```

support_tim: Noted. I've messaged the two impacted customers with ETA ~10m. Collecting any more reports.

alex_oncall: PD shows secondary auto-page fired due to duplicate alert; I acknowledged primary but autopager retried. Closing PD-12345 after we confirm recovery. Setting quiet window 20m: `/pd quiet 20m PD-12345`

ben_sre: p95 has dropped to ~700ms, p99 ~1900ms. Queue length trending down. Looks like the reduced batch size + scale helped.

carla_eng: Good. Followups: 1) add KV eviction alert (threshold 5/min), 2) revisit batcher hysteresis logic to avoid large queue ramps, 3) improve autopager suppression when human ack present.

incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 marked RESOLVED by alex_oncall. Final note: root cause likely batcher-led queueing under mixed high-throughput jobs causing cache churn. Mitigations applied: scale, reduced batch size, tenant reroute. Follow-up tickets: #INF-210 (batcher), #INF-211 (kv-alerts), #OPS-98 (autopager-suppress).

alex_oncall: I'll write up a short post-incident summary and hand off to eng-runtime for the follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ben_sre: +1, monitoring for 30m then we close the loop.

support_tim: Will update the two customers once stable.

incident-bot: This thread closed at 1801993460.
